does: Gives a combatant joining a combat its initiative: takes the value already kept for the entity in the combat's initiative map when there is one, otherwise calls esv::combat::System::NewInitiativeRoll.

evidence.says: calls the lookup at +0x3200710 (a hash map from entity to int reached through +0xB8 of the combat), and only when its found-flag is clear calls esv::combat::System::NewInitiativeRoll

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on (segments 19, 27, 36, 40, 42, 44, the same as the lookup it calls), from 1 place inside the per-tick combat function at +0x3206B50

questions.ask: whose initiative the map at +0xB8 keeps (a group sharing one roll, or a value set by script); joining a second enemy to a running fight would show whether it is found or rolled
